description: This bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for three different models—“M”, “XLM-R”, and “chLSTM”—across six distinct linguistic categories labeled L₁, L₂, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺ along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value”, ranges from 0 to 80 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three stacked bars corresponding to the three models, as indicated by the legend: “M” is represented by a light blue bar, “XLM-R” by a darker blue bar, and “chLSTM” by a green bar. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the categories listed along the horizontal axis. The “T” category shows the highest values, with the “chLSTM” bar reaching approximately 85, followed closely by the “XLM-R” bar at around 78, and the “M” bar at approximately 80. The “L₁” category shows moderate values, with “chLSTM” at approximately 35, “XLM-R” at approximately 30, and “M” at approximately 25. The “L₂” category shows lower values, with “chLSTM” at approximately 5, “XLM-R” at approximately 4, and “M” at approximately 3. The “R₁” category shows values around 30 for “chLSTM”, 25 for “XLM-R”, and 20 for “M”. The “R₂” category shows values around 10 for “chLSTM”, 8 for “XLM-R”, and 6 for “M”. The “R₃” category shows values around 5 for “chLSTM”, 3 for “XLM-R”, and 2 for “M”. The “R₄⁺” category shows values around 5 for “chLSTM”, 4 for “XLM-R”, and 3 for “M”. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
